description: Offense severity from the National Survey of Crime Severity, violent and non-violent ranked separately.
source_citation: Wolfgang, M., Figlio, R., Tracy, P. and Singer, S. (1985). The National Survey of Crime Severity. Washington, DC: U.S. Department of Justice, Bureau of Justice Statistics. NCJ-96017. Table 29 (national ratio scores).
notes: eb_prior_km2 is an area of citywide-average evidence added to every cell, so a cell's own figure carries weight area/(area+0.40): about 65% at resolution 8 and 21% at resolution 9, which is right since the smaller cells hold less data each. self_weight 0.6 leaves 0.4 for the mean of the ring-1 neighbours. Both are the first things to retune.
